item.title: Using AI to reverse engineer hardware
item.description:
📝 Only to discover that the chipset in the scanner had changed to one that wasn’t supported under Linux anymore. It can read thousands of lines of USB capture, notice that a sequence repeats with one byte changing, and propose what that byte means. Repeat the same operation on Linux with your own driver, and capture that the same way.
🔗 Read more: https://blogs.gnome.org/uraeus/2026/10/15/aiandreverseengineerhardware/

item.title: Prompt injection in HTTP headers: what 217M web responses show
item.description:
📝 Audit important sites with an agent’s user agent. Some sites use headers to push back on agents. How an indirect prompt injection reaches an agent.
🔗 Read more: https://www.signalscorps.com/blog/prompt-injection-in-http-headers/
